note: Accessibility violations main had when the gate arrived (2026-11-03), each with its reason: a11y.spec.mjs fails on any other. Fix one and delete its entry; never add one to get green. `target` is a regex on axe's selector; `designs` (optional) limits an entry.

known.why: Home's picks: the song title and artist are text links one line tall (17 px) with the next line close under them, under WCAG 2.2's 24 px. A larger invisible hit area needs room between the lines, which is a layout change in every design.
Album and artist tiles (Home, Search): the artist line under a tile title is a one-line text link.

Album and artist names as links on Home and Search: album tile titles, and the artist in song rows and in picks' reasons, each one line of text (17-18 px) where a tap target should be 24 px. The cover or row beside each opens the same page.
